advisories.detail: snapshot_production_boundary reads bytes of four production files for evidence; the reads are read-only and the tests assert the hashes do not change.
The harness always exits 3 while quarantined; automation that treats non-zero as failure will see the quarantine as red, which is the intended fail-closed signal.
